name: Steak and Peppers
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet. Sear steak strips, bell peppers and onion together with salt and red pepper flakes for a few minutes, then turn heat down and add crushed tomatoes and capers.
Simmer, covered, for 10 minutes or until steak is cooked through and tender.
Chiffonade the basil and add, then simmer for another couple of minutes.
